title: Your local provider just got an AI upgrade: All West Fiber teams up with RingCentral
summary: RingCentral has teamed up with All West Fiber to run more smoothly, with calls answered even after hours, less busywork, and insights from every conversation.
body_markdown:
Picture this: A small office in Kamas, Utah, the phone rings, and rings, and rings, but nobody answers because your team is busy helping other customers. So the call ends up in a voicemail inbox, lost forever. Your staff spends all day answering the same simple questions over and over again, reducing time that would be better spent on business critical tasks.


Good news, it doesn’t have to be this way. RingCentral has teamed up with All West Fiber to bring AI communications to Utah, Wyoming and Idaho. Now your business can run more smoothly, with calls answered even after hours, less busywork, and insights from every conversation.


All West Fiber has served local businesses for more than 110 years, and its business services include internet, phone, and TV. Today, we’re thrilled to offer business customers even more, including RingCentral’s award-winning Agentic Voice AI. Whether your business is just getting started or has been thriving for decades, All West can help you scale your communications so your staff can focus on what matters most.


## What’s this Agentic Voice AI everyone is talking about?


Think of it as a virtual assistant toolbox that handles your everyday customer conversations. Rather than just answering the phone, these tools understand exactly what your callers need. The AI can route calls based on context, book appointments, and answer routine questions on the spot. It even reads customer sentiment so it knows exactly when to smoothly transfer a caller to a live team member. That’s what makes it “agentic”. It goes beyond just talking, delivering a tailored solution for every person.


## Three tools, three ways to grow your business


[AI Receptionist (AIR)](https://www.ringcentral.com/ai-receptionist.html) answers every call. Losing business to missed calls? AIR picks up, sends the call where it needs to go, and books appointments. It works after hours, too, so no call goes unanswered and no opportunities are lost. That means your customers always get an answer, even when your team can’t pick up.


[AI Virtual Assistant (AVA)](https://www.ringcentral.com/products/ai-virtual-assistant.html) handles the busywork. Is your team stuck typing up notes and answering the same questions all day? AVA joins your calls and chats, then writes quick summaries, takes notes, and organizes your tasks automatically. It also answers common questions, like order status, hours, and availability. That saves your team from typing down everything people say, so they have more time for customers.


[AI Conversation Expert (ACE)](https://www.ringcentral.com/products/ai-conversation-expert) helps you learn from your calls. Reviewing customer calls manually takes time, so some never get the attention they deserve. ACE scores 100% of customer calls, scoring them, spotting trends, and suggesting improvements. That way, you can see what’s working, what’s not working, and better coach your team.


## Ready to get started?


Regardless of your business size, our partnership is here to help you grow. Call All West Fiber at 866-256-3966 to talk about what’s right for your business.


You can also visit[allwest.com/business-telecommunications](https://allwest.com/business-telecommunications) to learn more about All West Fiber, or[ringcentral.com](https://www.ringcentral.com/) to learn more about RingCentral.
